models._note: prefix hermes:<mode>/ or goose/ for ACP lanes; bare id = omp. Hermes 'default' mode parks on ANY edit (no approver) - use accept_edits and constrain writes in the brief.
models._roster_note: 2026-09-09 operator ruling: NO cx/* (gpt) models for subagents — not astra, sol, spark, or the bare `gpt` alias. The only permitted gpt is cx/gpt-5.6-luna (= 9router `gpt-mini`), and it is not in any forge lane. Lanes: glm-5.3(-flash) + ocg/deepseek-v4-pro. ocg/* needs x-opencode-session (Hermes sends it).
models._ocg_note: ocg/* recovered 2026-09-10 ~20:50 WIB (MissingSessionID gone). Two independent GLM quotas: glm/* (Z.ai direct, 5h window) and ocg/glm-* (OpenCode Go). Preflight rotates across all of them.

_workspace_note: Operator rule: all forge subagents run inside the orchestrator's own Paseo workspace (Kaneo Project Feature). Never --new-workspace. Implementers get a plain git worktree under .forge/worktrees/.
_parent_note: forge lanes are labelled paseo.parent-agent-id=<orchestrator session> so they render as subagents of that session and are swept with it.
